scenario: [LEXP.7.14.1]: `1 << 63` is INT64_MIN -- the last in-range count, shifting a 1 into the sign bit under the Int wrap. The control for `shl_64_is_zero`: 63 must not saturate. Guard `(t.x << t.n) == -9223372036854775808` (admissible as a literal, [LGRA.2.7.3b]); fact_count 2 confirms it fired.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key
    n: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x << t.n) == -9223372036854775808
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
